scope: Check source-field provenance and map-code documentation. No outcome-based decoding, model inference, fitting or new performance evaluation.
table_transcription: Human-checked against rendered PDF Table 1 (PDF page 6, printed page 5) and Table A.1 (PDF page 11, printed page 10). Sample counts only; no choice statistics used.
comparison_assumptions: Paper Table 1's left/right utility row labels may refer to fixed directions or to original scenarios only. Compare sample-count patterns with this ambiguity disclosed. Agreement is a provenance clue, never authoritative numeric-code identification.
time_link_policy: Report exact matches first. Processed times have heterogeneous stored precision, so also report candidate raw times in [processed, processed+10^(-stored decimal digits)). This tests truncation compatibility without choices; ambiguous candidates remain unresolved and are not identities.
